examples.reason: Specs say 'Use: House', description describes 'Low Cost House' with PUF panels and plumbing — residential structure in industrial building MCAT.

routes.signal: Title explicitly names 'PEB' or 'Pre Engineered Building' and specs confirm prefab steel construction — these products fit the more specific sibling MCAT as well as the parent umbrella.

examples.title: Peb Structural Shed
examples.reason: Title explicitly names 'PEB Structural Shed' and specs confirm prefab steel with galvanized finish and industrial application — fits 'Pre Engineered Building Structure' sibling MCAT.

input_sources_used.citation_note: All verdicts are derived from the enriched_products data provided by the pipeline operator; images were visually analysed from provided base64/image files.
Sibling MCAT names ('Prefabricated Buildings', 'Modular Buildings', 'Prefabricated Structures', 'Pre Engineered Building Structure') drawn from provided taxonomy siblings list — not fabricated.

Agent 3 primary_segment (PEB for industrial warehouse/factory) and mcat_description used to ground all category belonging decisions; mcat_vagueness_signal.suspected_vague was not provided but MCAT is treated as coherent based on market context.
